TOOLS.GATES_DESC: Toggle the inputs (A, B) to adjust the values and watch the logic gate calculate the output in real time.
TOOLS.GATES_EXPLAIN_AND: Outputs 1 only if both inputs are 1.
TOOLS.GATES_EXPLAIN_OR: Outputs 1 if at least one input is 1.
TOOLS.GATES_EXPLAIN_NOT: Inverts the input value (0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0). (Note: single input gate, Switch B is disabled)
TOOLS.GATES_EXPLAIN_XOR: Outputs 1 if the inputs are different.
TOOLS.GATES_EXPLAIN_NAND: Inverted AND; outputs 0 only if both inputs are 1.
TOOLS.GATES_EXPLAIN_NOR: Inverted OR; outputs 1 only if both inputs are 0.
